title: Saved cards
summary: Customers can save a card and remove it again.

241:cards/kept-after-close.why: How long a closed account's card stays on file is a privacy promise to your customers, and only you can set it.
241:cards/kept-after-close.context: When an account is closed, its saved cards are not removed from the shop's records.
